name: Pond & stormwater-basin aquatic management for HOAs, business parks and public bodies in DuPage/Will/Kane/Lake (IL)
summary: Customers = annual aquatic-management contracts (an HOA, business park or public body with 1-25 ponds). Recurring revenue = seasonal program fee (biweekly algae/weed treatment, dye, water-quality readings, reports), spread evenly by the engine although work runs Apr-Oct. One-time revenue = aeration/fountain installs sold to a minority of new accounts. Founder is the first IDOA-licensed applicator (Aquatic category).
evidence_notes: Public prices: Wheaton Park District 2026 six ponds McCloud $14,550 / SOLitude $17,232 / Jones $44,200 [A, C7-S031]; Mokena 23 ponds $26,564 (McCloud) [C, C7-S032] and 2026 rebid for 25 ponds biweekly x 5 months with prevailing wage [C, DE-S018]; Lombard 3 wet ponds weekly $24,000 (2026) [A, C7-S034]; Hawthorn Woods 2026 budget $2,500 + $1,000 for two park ponds [A, DE-S023]; Vernon Hills $1,000-$1,400 per pond per season [C, C7-S033].

Public pond work in Illinois is procured as public works: prevailing wage (Mokena, Lincolnshire, Kane FPD) and performance/payment bonds (Kane FPD) [A, DE-S017; C, DE-S018, DE-S019]. Prevailing-wage rates MISSING (IDOL tables not extractable) [A, DE-S038].

Competition: ~15 private aquatic firms with ILG87 coverage in the Chicago metro (SOLitude/Rentokil, McCloud, Jones, Tigris, Rollins Aquatic Solutions, etc.), and many park districts/villages hold their own ILG87 coverage (self-perform risk) [A, DE-S025].
Licence: IDOA commercial applicator $300/3 yrs with Aquatic category; operators $240; certificate of insurance required [A, WS13-S023].
Equipment: Kasco VFX 1 HP 240V fountain list $4,345; 2 HP $7,216 [B, DE-S026]; dealer discount MISSING.
HOA (non-public) prices MISSING; modeled from municipal per-pond prices (E). Seasonality ignored by the engine (cash timing understated).
Owner draw $4,000/mo from month 13 (comparability); operating profit is before owner compensation.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: IDOA General Standards + Aquatic exams (online-proctored) [A, WS13-S023], insurance, ILG87 NOI; bids open Dec-Mar
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Kane FPD: ITB 2026-02-02 -> award 2026-03-10 [A, DE-S017]; Wheaton quotes Dec -> board Jan [A, C7-S031]
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Public bids + HOA/property-manager quote requests; 35 named public/HOA prospects [A, DE-S025 and bid sources]
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Wheaton took 3 quotes and awarded the low bid [A, C7-S031]; Grayslake/Kane award to lowest responsible bidder [C/A]
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Wheaton changed vendors twice in 8 years (ILM -> SOLitude -> McCloud) [A, C7-S031]; HOAs assumed stickier
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Annual contract $3,000/$4,200/$5,400: ~88% HOA/business-park accounts of ~2 ponds at $1,000-$2,500/pond [A, DE-S023; C, C7-S033] + ~12% public multi-pond contracts $12k-$27k [A, C7-S031, C7-S034; C, C7-S032]
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: ~12-18% of new accounts buy an aeration fountain at ~$5,500-$6,500 installed (Kasco 1 HP 240V list $4,345 [B, DE-S026] + electrical/labor E)
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Recurring COGS = algaecides/herbicides, dye, test reagents ~12-20% of program revenue (Stage C 12%, E); labor modeled as staff
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Dealer discount MISSING; assumes ~25% off list + electrician subcontract
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Bid prep, site visits, bond premium share, printed reports
drivers.dso_days__source: Municipal net-30 after board approval + monthly/seasonal invoicing

staff.notes: Chicago median pesticide applicator $49,550 [C, C2-S022] x1.2 load, ~9-month season incl. fountain installs/removals; conservative reflects prevailing wage on public jobs (rates MISSING). capex_per_hire = used truck + jon boat + sprayer.
